name: A non-dispatched call runs only the callee's own body
A base call in a loop looks for a query in the base body only
The loop check passes the call, not its method
A summary records whether a call is dispatched
A base call inside a helper is followed into the base body only
Witnesses are cached apart for dispatched and base calls
old: var key = new WitnessKey(definition, ArgumentShape(arguments), kind, depth, dispatched);
new: var key = new WitnessKey(definition, ArgumentShape(arguments), kind, depth, false);

name: A base call reads the navigations the base body reads
An element passed to a base call is checked against the base body
old: var reads = operation is IInvocationOperation call ? session.NavigationReadsOf(call, ordinal) : session.NavigationReadsOf(method, ordinal);

name: A base call returns what the base body returns
old: public SourceInfo ReturnsOf(IInvocationOperation call) => ReturnsOf(TargetsOf(call.TargetMethod, call.IsVirtual));
new: public SourceInfo ReturnsOf(IInvocationOperation call) => ReturnsOf(TargetsOf(call.TargetMethod, true));

name: The tracer follows the call, not its method
A base call in an override is no recursion
